gaps.detail: Neither surviving candidate has explicit commercial-use clearance documented in the wiki. ADNI (strong match) has an unspecified DUA with known academic-bias history; ASPREE (partial match) is PI-request-only with no stated licensing terms. The orchestrator should flag this as a pre-commitment blocker and recommend the buyer verify DUA terms before signing any project agreement.

Both surviving candidates use targeted lipidomics (LC-MS/MS QqQ or UHPLC-QTOF, 781 and 724 species respectively), not broad untargeted metabolomics. If the buyer requires untargeted metabolomics (e.g. amino acids, organic acids, TCA intermediates beyond lipids), neither cohort satisfies the scope. The request did not specify targeted vs untargeted — buyer should confirm.

Only 4 cohort entities exist in the wiki; 3 are AD-indication, 2 survive hard filters. The request space (longitudinal plasma metabolomics in AD, n>=200) is much larger than the current wiki can answer. Recommend orchestrator evaluates whether to trigger ingest for additional AD plasma metabolomics papers (suggested PubMed query: 'Alzheimer disease plasma metabolomics longitudinal biomarker validation').

ASPREE partial candidate has no medication_and_lifestyle_confounders dimension covered (provenance_depth 0.14). Statin prevalence in an elderly Australian RCT population is likely high but is not documented in the wiki entity. This is a soft concern, not a disqualifier, but the buyer's explicit statin concern warrants surfacing.

The request did not mention MCI or prodromal AD. Both ADNI cohorts enroll MCI participants co-enrolled with AD — the buyer should confirm whether MCI-to-AD conversion sub-cohorts within ADNI are acceptable, as they expand the usable analytical N and enable conversion prediction modelling.

verdict_reason: 1 strong candidate (adni-go2-plasma-lipidomics) and 1 partial candidate (aspree-dementia-casecohort-lipidomics) survive hard filters; the strong match is well-evidenced but has unresolved commercial-use and modality-scope gaps; wiki coverage is thin (4 total cohort entities) and targeted lipidomics is the only available modality — orchestrator should decide whether to proceed with the 2 matches or trigger ingest for broader AD plasma metabolomics coverage.
